name: Doomed Love
source:
I made a dating sim where you can romance the monsters from Doom! "Doomed Love" features:

 - four demons to date
 - five endings 
 - all original art/music
 - absolutely no gore or violence!

[From [url=https://davidbcooper.itch.io/doomed-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我做了一款恋爱模拟游戏，让你能与《毁灭战士》里的怪物谈恋爱！《Doomed Love》包含以下内容。

 - 四位可约会的恶魔
 - 五种结局
 - 全部原创的美术与音乐
 - 绝对没有血腥与暴力！

[摘自[url=https://davidbcooper.itch.io/doomed-love]itch.io[/url]]
